scope.flow: Monetrix Accountant settlement pipeline: PrecompileReader.suppliedBalance() reads HyperCore 0x811 user state, MonetrixAccountant.totalBackingSigned()/_readL1Backing() sums gross supply into backing, and settleDailyPnL()/settle()/distributeYield() use distributableSurplus() as the yield bound
scope.environment: Monetrix protocol on-chain contracts (src/core/PrecompileReader.sol, src/core/MonetrixAccountant.sol, src/core/MonetrixVault.sol) reading HyperCore precompile 0x811 borrow/lend user token state

entities.name: HyperCore precompile 0x811 borrow/lend user token state
L1 account with 0x811 supply position and borrow liability

statements.text: The 0x811 user state is a borrow/lend user token state containing both supply.value and borrow.value, not a pure supply balance.
PrecompileReader.suppliedBalance() decodes the 0x811 tuple and keeps only the fourth decoded word (supply.value).

MonetrixAccountant.totalBackingSigned() calls _readL1Backing() for the Vault and multisig L1 accounts, and for each registered supplied slot adds suppliedUsdcEvm(account) or suppliedNotionalUsdcFromPerp(...) to backing.
There is no matching read of borrow.value, no netting, and no check that the account has zero 0x811 borrow liability.
An L1 account has a counted 0x811 supply position and a 0x811 borrow liability.
Gate 3 in settleDailyPnL() requires proposedYield <= distributableSurplus().
The Operator calls the normal, code-bounded settle() pipeline.
The Operator calls the normal, code-bounded distributeYield() pipeline.
The Accountant's on-chain safety bound overstates backing because distributableSurplus() is computed from gross 0x811 supply while ignoring 0x811 borrow debt.
Monetrix can overstate USDM backing by the ignored borrow amount.
If the real net backing has no surplus but totalBackingSigned() reports surplus because it counted gross supply, settle() can move principal USDC from the Vault to YieldEscrow as if it were yield.
The PoC demonstrates a 10,000 USDC unsupported yield distribution; after distribution sUSDM assets increased while USDM is underbacked by the same 10,000 USDC amount.

Operator-submitted yield must be bounded by real distributable surplus, computed net of 0x811 borrow liabilities, so that settle()/distributeYield() cannot move principal USDC as yield. (inferred from the report's description of Gate 3's purpose and the ignored borrow debt.)
A PM/BLP borrow liability must exist for the overstatement to occur.

ambiguities: Report does not state that anyone can call settle()/distributeYield(); the Operator is described as the normal caller, so no unauthorized-caller precondition is included.
The 10,000 USDC PoC figure is asserted as demonstrated, but the report does not establish the specific prior on-chain state (exact borrow amount, account identity) as a precondition.
The report notes the root issue is broader (cross-token PM state would also need borrowed-token liabilities valued), but no concrete cross-token scenario values are supplied.
Whether the L1 account's borrow liability pre-exists the settlement action or is created in the same scenario is not specified.
